# HardwareFit

> Offline LLM VRAM and local GPU/RAM hardware fit calculator running entirely in your browser with zero server uploads.

## Overview
HardwareFit is an official zero-tracking-cookie, client-side utility in the OTHRYS Fleet.
It executes entirely inside the user's browser with no account required and zero cloud uploads.

- **Canonical URL:** https://hardwarefit.othrys.be/
- **Category:** AI & Local Hardware Tools
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side In-Browser Execution
- **Privacy:** Zero tracking cookies, zero third-party trackers, zero cloud uploads.
- **Agent Manifest:** https://hardwarefit.othrys.be/.well-known/agents.txt
